scope: Dev observation-model study, all registered seeds; historical controls reevaluated, not retrained
limitations: Rolling periods overlap. Seeds and repeated forecasts are not new independent observations.
Uncensored CRPS/order loss and conditional coverage do not establish full latent-demand calibration.
Aggregate lower-bound and joint daily NLL are different scores and are never subtracted from each other.
Joint daily likelihood assumes symmetric Dirichlet allocation with concentration 4 and noninformative daily right censoring; raw neural parameters are preserved.
This comparison measures emitted F and orders, not a full manager-request rollout.

publishedRaw.scope: All three new small GRU checkpoints, Train source-held-out losses and fitted allocation parameters, exact Dev predictions/orders/targets, registrations, matched-control identities and logs. Historical full ModernBERT and control weights and expanded input captures are not bundled.

timingScope: Recorded study progress plus completion diagnostic; excludes preparation and intervening wall time.

completion.reason: The seed helper sets CPU threads to 1. The historical CPU reference used 4 threads. Same fixed weights and deterministic algorithms reproduce the mismatch at 1 thread and exact predictions/orders at 4 threads.

peakGpuNote: The process exited before exporting its peak GPU counter; no estimate substitutes for that missing measurement.
